rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for bringing or transporting a package or other item to its destination.

example.english: We will deliver the package to your home tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋會聽日將個包裹送到你屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 ting1 jat6 zoeng1 go3 baau1 gwo2 sung3 dou3 nei5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when handing a person or thing over to another person or authority, especially the police.

example.english: The police demanded that we deliver the suspect to them.
example.traditional: 警方要求我哋將疑犯交畀佢哋。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 ji4 faan6 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use this specifically for giving a speech or formal spoken presentation.

example.english: They will deliver a speech at the conference next week.
example.traditional: 佢下星期要喺大會上做演講。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 hai2 daai6 wui6 soeng6 zou6 jin2 gong2

rows.note: Use this specifically when a doctor or midwife assists with the birth of a baby.

example.english: The doctor helped deliver our baby.
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 bong1 ngo5 lou5 po4 zip3 saang1
